column1: After you have displayed your badge, the patron says: "So what?"
column2: 你出示警徽後，客人說：「所以呢？」

column1: You show your badge and the customer lashes out..."Whatsa matter, am I holding my fork wrong or something?"
column2: 你出示警徽，客人怒道……「怎麼了？難道我叉子拿錯了嗎？」

column1: Good day officer. he says, after you have displayed your badge.
column2: 你出示警徽後，他說：「日安，警官。」

column1: Quit flashing your badge at the wall!
column2: 別再對著牆亮警徽了！

column1: Being the big tipper you are, you throw down $5.00.
column2: 你一向出手闊綽，丟下 5 美元小費。

column1: Oops! You're down to your last cash...better not leave a tip!
column2: 糟糕！你只剩最後一點現金……最好別給小費！

column1: Most people wait until they've finished eating.
column2: 大多數人會等吃完飯再做這件事。

column1: You might as well eat your food before paying for it.
column2: 你不如先把食物吃完再付錢。

column1: Good food takes a little time.
column2: 好食物需要一點時間。

column1: So...go sit down and order some food, first!
column2: 所以……先去坐下點餐！

column1: Have some patience! The waiter will take your order.
column2: 耐心一點！服務生會來替你點餐。

column1: There's food on your plate...eat it if you're hungry.
column2: 你的盤子裡有食物……餓了就吃吧。

column1: Have some patience with the poor waiter!
column2: 對可憐的服務生耐心一點！

column1: Your food is on the way.
column2: 你的餐點正在送來。

column1: The waiter's in back flirting with the cook.
column2: 服務生在後面和廚師調情。

column1: Your choice comes with the meal.
column2: 你的選擇會隨餐點附上。

column1: Sit down first.
column2: 先坐下。

column1: Maybe a little later.
column2: 也許晚一點。

column1: You feel like eating something before you have a drink.
column2: 你想先吃點東西再喝飲料。

column1: Sit at the table in order to eat.
column2: 坐到桌邊才能吃東西。

column1: You've already cleaned your plate.
column2: 你已經把盤子吃得一乾二淨。

column1: Can't you tell from the taste in your mouth that you're already eating?
column2: 你嘴裡的味道還不夠明顯嗎？你已經在吃了。

column1: You don't have any food of your own yet.
column2: 你目前還沒有自己的食物。

column1: She already has them.
column2: 她已經有了。

column1: Why don't you sit down first?
column2: 你為什麼不先坐下？
